verdict.rationale: Asaas documents an Asaas Checkout where card data is entered on a page Asaas controls, which reduces PCI scope. It also offers payment links and a hosted payment page where, with billingType UNDEFINED, the payer chooses among the enabled payment methods. Together these let a developer send customers to a vendor-hosted page instead of building a payment UI. Missing for 10: no in-depth docs on the checkout/redirect flow itself (session creation, redirect URLs, customization), no evidence the page is conversion-optimized, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
